title: The four communication styles (assertive vs. aggressive vs. passive vs. passive-aggressive)
content: There are roughly four styles: passive (going along with others, avoiding conflict, often at your own cost), aggressive (getting your needs met at others' expense, sometimes through anger or force), passive-aggressive (indirect resistance, sarcasm, silent treatment, when direct expression feels too risky), and assertive (clearly expressing your needs while still respecting the other person). None of these is a fixed personality trait. Most people shift between styles depending on the situation and who they're with.
